note: Deathskips the guides do not carry. die: where to die (world yards, m 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor); graveyard: the world_safe_locs name it gives; filter: who may use it (as in the guides); approx: the place is estimated, check it in game; off: known but the place is not yet known.

skips.name: Menethil Harbor -> Dun Morogh (Kharanos)
skips.how: Swim west of the Theramore boat dock in Menethil Harbor until the subzone text shows Dun Morogh, then drown.
skips.source: community knowledge (Warcraft Tavern, Death Skipping from Kalimdor to Eastern Kingdoms); place estimated

skips.name: Ironforge / Dun Morogh -> Wetlands (Menethil Harbor)
skips.how: Climb the mountains north of Ironforge, jump down towards the Wetlands and die from the fall.
skips.source: RestedXP Forever guides (Guides/Forever/dungeon/Alliance-11-20.lua: the Dun Morogh -> Wetlands deathskip location)

skips.name: The Barrens -> Westfall (Sentinel Hill)
skips.how: From Ratchet run to an unlisted map area (a mountain cleft) in the southern Barrens and die: with no graveyard for the area the Alliance default graveyard, Sentinel Hill, takes the ghost.
skips.source: community knowledge (Warcraft Tavern); the exact place is not published
